article.title: NFL EDGE Sunday Morning Brief
article.dek: Detroit moved two points in a day, the Value card is back, and Tampa Bay's two questionable stars get their answer at the inactives.

items.headline: Mayfield and Evans are both expected to play in Detroit
paragraphs: Baker Mayfield is expected to play today at Detroit, barring a setback. That is the word from Tom Pelissero of The Ringer, and the Sunday morning update says the same: he will play.

Here is what he is playing through. Mayfield has a plantar fascia injury in his foot, plus a thumb issue. He is expected to wear a special orthotic and new cleats. He is officially questionable. He sat out Wednesday and practiced on a limited basis Thursday and Friday.

Mike Evans is expected back too, after limited practices Thursday and Friday. He is also officially questionable. Tampa Bay is short-handed on defense, though: safety Antoine Winfield Jr. is out with an ankle injury.

It is not final until the inactives come out, about 90 minutes before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff. If Mayfield cannot go, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels would start. The app lists Mayfield as Tampa Bay's expected starter.
items.takeaway: Mayfield and Evans are both expected to play, but both are officially questionable — the inactives settle it about 90 minutes before kickoff. Winfield Jr. is out.

items.headline: Arizona's quarterback is settled, and the app has him
paragraphs: Carson Beck is out with back spasms, and Josh Johnson starts today at Kansas City. That makes Johnson Arizona's fourth starting quarterback in four weeks. Rookie Joey Aguilar is the backup.
The app's quarterback snapshot updated this morning and now lists Johnson as Arizona's expected starter. The numbers for this game reflect the change.
The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, not 16.5, and it still put no card on this game. A gap is a starting point, not a bet.
items.takeaway: Beck is out and Josh Johnson starts at Kansas City. The app has updated, and it still has no card on this game.

items.headline: Drake Maye is out indefinitely
paragraphs: Drake Maye fractured his right fibula. It will not need surgery, but he is expected to miss some time, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. He is out indefinitely.
New England is not on today's board, so it changes nothing on this slate. It is still the biggest quarterback news of the weekend, and it matters next week when the Patriots return to the board.
items.takeaway: Maye fractured his right fibula and is out indefinitely. New England does not play today, so nothing changes on this slate.

items.headline: Weather: rain in Chicago and at MetLife, wind in two spots
paragraphs: Rain is likely at kickoff in Chicago and at MetLife for Jaguars at Giants. Chicago gets 56 degrees with wind at 15 mph gusting to 24 and a 91 percent chance of rain. MetLife gets 61 degrees, light wind, and a 63 percent chance of light rain.

Philadelphia's rain chance has dropped to 42 percent, with 64 degrees and light wind. Kansas City stays dry but windy: 48 degrees, mostly sunny, wind 15 mph gusting to 24. Carolina gets a 39 percent chance of light rain, Buffalo is clear at 66 degrees, Denver is clear at 43 degrees, and Mexico City is fair at 62 degrees for the night game.
That is the weather, plain and simple. It is not a totals edge, and it does not change what the app says. Note it, then bet the numbers.
items.takeaway: Rain likely in Chicago and at MetLife. Wind about 15 mph in Chicago and Kansas City. Philadelphia's rain chance has dropped. Mild everywhere else.

items.headline: How to read today's three cards
paragraphs: All three cards are live again. Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline at -255, the most likely winner on the board. The app gives Jacksonville about a 74 percent chance, against about 72 percent needed to break even at that price. A -255 price means every $2.55 you risk wins $1.

Balanced is Jets +3 at -102, about a coin flip and the middle ground — a strong pick without paying too much. The app gives the Jets about a 51 percent chance, against about 50 percent needed to break even.

Value is back. Giants +6 at -109 was not on a card last night, and it is the Value pick again this morning. The app gives the Giants about 52.5 percent, against about 52.2 percent needed — barely over the line. If your book has a Giants price you like, Check it and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator.
items.takeaway: Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline -255, the most likely winner. Balanced is Jets +3 at -102, about a coin flip. Value is Giants +6 at -109, barely over the line.

items.headline: The app still thinks the big spreads are too fat, and it still bet none of them
paragraphs: Look at the gaps. The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, not 15.5. Buffalo by about 3.4, not 16.5. Chicago by about 0.2, not 11.5. Detroit by about 1.7, not 3.5.

Detroit is the one that moved. The market came two points toward the app's number in a day, and the app still put no dog on a card. A gap is a starting point, not a bet. The card is what the model and the evaluator agreed on after the full check.

If one of those dogs catches your eye at your book, do not just take it. Type the line and the price into Check and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator. That is what Check is for.
items.takeaway: Big spreads, big model gaps, zero cards on the dogs. The gap alone is not the bet. Check your price.

items.headline: The juice: what -110 really costs you
paragraphs: Every price has the book's cut built in, and that cut has a name: the juice. At -110, you risk $1.10 to win $1. That extra 10 cents is the juice.

Here is a clearly labeled hypothetical example. Imagine you bet $11 on two different games, both at -110, and you split them — one win, one loss. The winner pays back $21, your $11 stake plus $10 profit. The loser costs you $11. You went 1-1 and you are still down $1. That is the juice doing its job.

That is why the app shows a break-even number on every card. At -110 you have to win more than half your bets just to break even. The price tells you what you win. The break-even number tells you what you need.
items.takeaway: At -110 you have to win more than half your bets just to break even — the juice is why the app's break-even number matters more than the price alone.

items.headline: Detroit moved another full point overnight
paragraphs: Detroit went from -4.5 last night to -3.5 this morning on DraftKings and FanDuel. That is a second full point toward Tampa Bay, and two points in a day from the -5.5 of Saturday morning.
The market is moving toward the app's number. The app has Detroit winning by about 1.7, not 3.5. The +5.5 is gone from the board, and now the +4.5 is gone too.
If your book still shows a Detroit price you like and Check says bet, bet now. Waiting already cost Tampa Bay backers two points in a day, and a good number today beats a hoped-for number at kickoff.
items.takeaway: Detroit moved another full point to -3.5, two points in a day from -5.5. The +5.5 and the +4.5 are both gone from the board.

items.headline: Kansas City came in a point on DraftKings
paragraphs: DraftKings moved Kansas City from 16.5 to 15.5 against Arizona. FanDuel held at 16.5. The books disagree by a full point on the same game, and that is exactly when Check earns its keep.

The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, so the market is still far from the app's number on either book. The direction is toward the app, but the distance is still wide, and the app put no card on this game.
items.takeaway: DraftKings moved Kansas City to 15.5 while FanDuel held at 16.5. The books disagree by a point — Check your book's line.

items.headline: The Jets-Chargers total dropped a point
paragraphs: The Jets at Chargers total went from 42.5 to 41.5 on DraftKings, and FanDuel shows 41.5 too. That is a full point down overnight.

The app's total for that game sits near 46, so the market is still well short of the app's number — but the direction is down. If your book still shows 42.5, Check it. If it shows 41.5, Check that too.
items.takeaway: The Jets-Chargers total dropped a full point to 41.5. The app's total sits near 46, so the market is still well short.

items.headline: The Value card is back, and the other two got a touch cheaper
paragraphs: Giants +6 at -109 is a Value card again this morning, after the lane sat empty last night. The line and price are the same as Saturday morning. Nothing about the Giants changed. The app just decided the card earns its place again.

The other two cards got a touch cheaper. The Jaguars moneyline is -255 on DraftKings, down from -256 last night. The Jets are +3 at -102, down from -105 on Saturday morning. A cheaper price on the same pick is a better price.
items.takeaway: Value is back with Giants +6 at -109. Jaguars moneyline is -255 and Jets +3 is -102, both a touch cheaper.

items.headline: Game day: check the inactives, then trust the board
paragraphs: The inactives come out about 90 minutes before kickoff — 11:30 a.m. ET for the 1:00 p.m. ET games. That is when Mayfield and Evans get their final answer. Check the inactives, then Check your prices.
The board refreshes every morning and evening, so the numbers you see now are the numbers for today. Do not carry last night's prices into today's games.
Three cards are live, the Value card is back, and Detroit has moved twice. Check your prices against the board you have now, not the one you had yesterday.
items.takeaway: Inactives come out about 90 minutes before kickoff. Check them, then Check your prices against today's board — not last night's.
